description: Land Title Settlement Department - Padawgama,  Lunugamwehera D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830041
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and the declaration of title determinations for specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership status (all listed as "The State"), and encumbrances. The content falls under the Land Gazette category as it pertains to land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters under the Registration of Title Act.
